mechanism: Eslicarbazepine may reduce iron absorption through effects on gastric pH and gastrointestinal motility, and iron may chelate eslicarbazepine in the GI tract reducing its bioavailability.
action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor for signs of iron deficiency anemia and eslicarbazepine efficacy; consider monitoring serum iron and eslicarbazepine levels if clinically indicated.
